source_grounded_interface_conclusions.conclusion: self.messages is built from prompt_builder.init_messages; no structured plan object is exposed. A model-authored record must use an existing model-visible carrier.
One role=tool message with the matching tool_call_id is appended, and small successful results are stored under var_<tool_call_id>. These are structural provenance keys, not semantic support.
Large successful results are written to a file with a preview; failed calls are not stored as data. The validator treats large results as truncated and failed calls as failed.

The assistant tool-call message is appended before dispatch, so a result dispatched in response N is first available at N+1. DataAgent.run catches exceptions into final_result and terminate_reason; instrumentation must swallow its own failures.
The existing sidecar declares self_observation.freeform as a string, preserves it, and pops the sidecar before base dispatch. This is the selected formal carrier.
call_llm is an existing bounded runtime boundary that appends a user-role notice. G11 uses the same boundary for at most one structural guidance message per model turn.

An outer wrapper can read the raw tool-call arguments before the self-observation subclass pops the sidecar and can observe dispatch without replacing it. G11 is installed after the carrier, deadline, and G2 wrappers.
return_answer is terminal and model-authored; the standalone self-observation tool is also model-authored. Both are non-evidence and cannot resolve a ledger reference.

no_leak_review.g11_extractor: reads only G11 sidecar and summary files; never opens task, answer, hint, validator, conversation, tool-argument, tool-result, trace, or credential files
no_leak_review.g11_guidance: exact fixed template; no task content, identifiers, arguments, results, or semantic status
no_leak_review.existing_observation_log: G11 record payload is skipped when G11 is enabled; ordinary non-record observations follow the original path
no_leak_review.base_tool_dispatch_arguments: G11 record sidecar is removed before base dispatch when G11 is enabled
no_leak_review.model_context_trace: the model-authored record remains in the assistant tool-call context; the G11 extractor never reads the upstream model-call trace

unresolved_risks: Live provider acceptance of the declared freeform carrier is not exercised by a no-task fixture; only declared-schema conformance is proven.
A real model's willingness and ability to author the exact record and copy opaque identifiers accurately remain unknown.
A real model's compliance with bounded structural guidance remains unknown; zero guidance binding means the mechanism is untested.
Real-DAB wrapper inertness is not established; only synthetic enabled-versus-disabled checks were run.
The upstream model-call trace retains the model-authored record in model context; G11 never reads or exports it, but a future formal no-leak review should confirm the model-context boundary.
The G11 sidecar is written at task end; an abrupt external process kill may lose structural rows. This does not change dispatch or scoring.

The installer is per-process/per-task, consistent with the existing runner sidecars; reusing one imported DataAgent class for multiple tasks in a single process is not exercised by the synthetic tests.
The candidate snapshot omits external DataAgent source and some inherited runtime dependencies; the complete inherited suite has 14 pre-existing failures, identical before and after G11.
